name: Salt cedar
desc: Salt cedar (Tamarix ramosissima): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Tamarix ramosissima, commonly known as saltcedar salt cedar, or tamarisk, is a deciduous arching shrub with reddish stems, feathery, pale green foliage, and characteristic small pink flowers.
